evals.prompt: I committed my changes in a linked Git worktree on feature/search-work. Sync them to feature/search in the original repository. The target is checked out there, clean, and an ancestor of my source commit. Describe the commands and checks without modifying a real repository.
evals.expected_output: Verify the explicitly named target and shared Git metadata, inspect its checkout, fast-forward with merge --ff-only from the target worktree, and verify the target ref and checkout. Do not publish upstream or create a merge commit.
assertions: Checks the shared repository, target branch, clean checkout, and source ancestry before updating.
Uses merge --ff-only in the target worktree and verifies the result without publishing upstream.

evals.prompt: I rebased feature/search in an isolated clone. Sync it through the local backlink to feature/search in my original repository. The original branch has the old, divergent history and is not checked out. I have not approved a history replacement. Describe the next action without modifying a real repository.
evals.expected_output: Verify the local destination, capture the target commit directly, show destination-only commits, and ask for explicit approval. Explain that a later approved replacement uses an exact force-with-lease; perform no push yet.
assertions: Stops and asks for explicit approval after showing the divergent source and destination histories.
Describes a later approved local replacement with a lease tied to the directly observed target commit, not a cached tracking ref.

evals.prompt: Sync the completed work from this isolated child session. Its checkout branch is child/temporary, no originating branch or commit was supplied, and the only remote is origin on GitHub. Describe the next action without modifying a real repository.
evals.expected_output: Stop and ask for the originating source identity and original local target. Do not infer correspondence from the temporary branch, create a commit, or publish to origin.
assertions: Asks for the originating source branch or commit and original local target rather than guessing from child/temporary.
Performs no Git update and does not use the network origin as a local sync destination.
